exposure: Mobile health (mHealth) app-based postnatal educational program (4-week access)
outcome: Parents' views and experiences regarding the content and delivery of the mHealth app
cohort: Seventeen multi-ethnic parents of newborns who had previously participated in the intervention group of a randomized controlled trial.
finding: Parents found the mHealth app-based educational program to be a helpful and trustworthy source of information, tailored to the local context, that provided support and a sense of community during the postnatal period.
